aliasResolution: Accept a returned versioned Jev model ID; preserve it in receipts. Pinned requests require an exact model match. Alias targets above are documentation snapshots, not permanent mappings.

validation.toleranceSource: local defensive policy; provider docs specify normalization but no wire rounding tolerance
validation.choice: exact keys, known argmax choice, finite probabilities and confidence in [0,1]
validation.noul: finite probability in [0,1], no confidence field
validation.score: exact levels and legend, finite weighted mean

quota: none imposed; organization provider limits remain authoritative
